query: How does resolution time vary across issue themes, channel, and priority?

per_column.name: issue_theme
per_column.rationale: Directly named in the query; well-separated interpretable themes with reasonable spread; strong segmentation variable to compare resolution time across.

per_column.name: operational_severity
per_column.rationale: Ordinal, interpretable scale from no_impact to service_down with balanced categories; a classic associational driver of resolution time.

per_column.name: blast_radius
per_column.rationale: Interpretable scope categories (single_user to multi_tenant) that segment cleanly; plausibly related to resolution effort, distinct from severity.

per_column.name: root_cause_category
per_column.rationale: Interpretable causal categories that support meaningful grouping; heavy NULL share (~30%) weakens but does not eliminate its comparative value.

per_column.name: requires_escalation
per_column.rationale: Escalation path is well-separated and strongly associated with resolution time; good interpretable segmentation.

per_column.name: workaround_available
per_column.rationale: Interpretable, but heavily concentrated in no_workaround/not_present with tiny minority classes, limiting the contrast that can be drawn.

per_column.name: data_sensitivity_flag
per_column.rationale: Interpretable sensitivity categories, though dominated by not_present (~75%), reducing segmentation power.

per_column.name: data_sensitivity_or_compliance_flag
per_column.rationale: Near-duplicate of data_sensitivity_flag with essentially identical category distribution; adds no new relationship.

judge.rationale: The set provides multiple external, interpretable, well-separated segmentation dimensions (issue_theme, operational_severity, blast_radius, requires_escalation, root_cause_category) that genuinely support exploring how resolution_minutes varies, directly serving the query. Weaknesses: one column (data_sensitivity_or_compliance_flag) is a redundant restatement of another, and several columns (workaround_available, data_sensitivity_flag) are heavily dominated by a single value, limiting meaningful contrast. Overall strong for EDA but with some redundancy and imbalance.
